name: beautijoo
description: Beautijoo - Persian RTL marketplace and booking platform for beauty professionals

scripts.build:
cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && rm -rf ../.next && cp -a .next ../.next && mkdir -p ../.next/standalone/.next && cp -a .next/static ../.next/standalone/.next/static && if [ -d public ]; then cp -a public/. ../.next/standalone/public/ 2>/dev/null || true; fi && if [ -f ../.next/standalone/server.js ]; then mv ../.next/standalone/server.js ../.next/standalone/next-server.js && printf '%s
' "process.env.HOSTNAME = '0.0.0.0';" "require('./next-server.js');" > ../.next/standalone/server.js; fi && mkdir -p ../public && if [ -d public ]; then cp -a public/. ../public/ 2>/dev/null || true; fi
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
